summary: A Depth subscription on an equity: Nubra's order-book message gives LTP, volume and the book padded to five levels; a message with no resting orders clears the book.

deviations.reason: Nubra's order book carries no last quantity; the desktop's Depth frame sends it as 0 (NubraFeed marks nothing absent), the web leaves it out. A field the stream does not carry must be left out (web openalgo#2376).

Both pad a short side to five levels; the web's padding levels carry price 0 (an integer), the desktop's 0.0. Lead rule 2026-11-09: number types follow the web adapter; lane wire to settle padded books for every broker.
